method: Production React; minified build; native scroll events; 60 measured RAF intervals per run, three repetitions. Mount excludes fixture construction, sync excludes frame settling. Scrolling includes browser script/layout/style but no CPU profiler or tracing. Fixed 1200x512 scroller, 32px rows, row overscan 4, column overscan 2. Plain text cells and one input column. Cold load and network excluded.
